cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my interest in the MLOps job posting for your logistics startup. Your need for containerised model services, monitoring dashboards, and a retraining pipeline aligns with my expertise in MLops, Docker, Kubernetes, and FastAPI.

I have previously worked on a project [aiml-case-10] where I migrated an MLOps platform, addressing the issue of models being retrained manually without proper tracking. This project involved setting up a K8s-based core for autoscaling and a Mlflow-based core for tracking experiments and monitoring drift after launch.

Another relevant project is [aiml-repo-05], a production-tested service that I developed for a client. This service uses Docker and FastAPI, and it was created to address the issue of models being retrained manually without proper version control.

I am confident, however, that with proper planning and communication, we can mitigate this risk.

I am available to start immediately and can dedicate the required 3 to 6 months for this project.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my qualifications further.

Sincerely, Amina Okafor

cover_letter: We are excited to apply for the Time Series Forecasting for Weekly Sales job. Our experience in demand forecasting and proficiency in Python and scikit-learn make us a strong candidate for this role. In a previous project, we successfully delivered a Grid Load Forecasting service [aiml-case-16]. We used gradient-boosted trees and logistic regression baselines with cross-validation for forecasting, and built classical baselines using scikit-learn. We also set up a scheduled retraining job and provided a backtest report. Our service was delivered as a single image that the client's ops team could run with a single command.

You want "Power BI dashboard for insurance KPIs" delivered (Power BI report, documented measures, refresh schedule), and the part that decides success is usually power bi.

On power bi: sql, python, pandas, power bi, tableau, excel, dbt, snowflake, bigquery, google analytics, a/b [data-cv]. On sql: I used sql to model and query the sales data [data-case-01]. On excel: I used excel to hand the finance team a model they could edit [data-case-10].

My plan: confirm the scope and acceptance criteria in a short call, deliver a first working version early, then iterate with you on the details. I will also cover Understanding of insurance KPIs.

I propose $55/hr for this scope. Could you share what a successful first milestone looks like for you?

cover_letter:
Dear Retail Team,

My extensive experience in data cleaning and analysis, particularly with Excel, pandas, and data wrangling, makes me an ideal candidate for this project.

In my previous work, I have successfully tackled similar projects, such as the CRM Deduplication and Clean-Up engagement where I wrote a production-tested service to merge duplicate records and fix broken dates. This service, named dedupe-crm, is still in use by one of my clients. You can find more details about this project in the provided evidence.

For the cleaned master file, I would propose a multi-step approach. First, I would use data wrangling techniques to clean and standardize the data. Then, I would use Excel to create a model that can be easily edited by your team. Lastly, I would implement tests to ensure the data's integrity.

I am available to start this project within the next two weeks. I look forward to discussing this opportunity further and demonstrating how my skills and experience can benefit your team.

Best regards, Priya Raman
